full_name: Mélanie Lamotte | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 History Radcliffe Institute Fellow Tulane University
bio: Mélanie Lamotte is an assistant professor and Andrew W. Mellon Junior Professor at Tulane University. She is a historian of race and colonialism in the early modern period. Her work focuses on the French colonial world, with a concentration on Guadeloupe in the Caribbean, French Louisiana, and Île Bourbon, in the southwest Indian Ocean.
